criteria.name: Requirements Coverage
criteria.note: All 12 acceptance criteria (AC-1 through AC-12) have at least one dedicated test. Each criteria maps to a named test class or method.

criteria.name: Edge Case Coverage
criteria.note: Edge cases covered: empty repo, empty NVD cache, all-VEX-suppressed, duplicate PURLs, multi-repo rejection, unknown format, unknown environment, NVDSyncError propagation, fresh vs stale cache boundary at exactly 7 days. Two minor gaps (unknown tool in adapter, malformed JSON in sync feed) are covered by Step 5/6 unit tests and do not constitute orchestration-level failures.

criteria.name: Internal Consistency
criteria.note: ScanWorkflowState enum (7 states), NVDSyncWorkflowState enum (4 states), and EXPECTED_STATE_ORDER lists are consistent with the DDM extraction ledger. ScanResult dataclass fields match AC-11. No contradictions found between test classes.

criteria.name: Assumption Transparency
criteria.note: All DDM workflow sources cited with document, section, and confidence. CQ-2 resolution documented. 7-day staleness threshold sourced. Stubs carry explicit NotImplementedError referencing Step 9. Import from step6_tdd_green_phase (non-standard name) is explained in comment.

criteria.name: Error Path Coverage
criteria.note: Covered: validation failure aborts before scanning, NVDSyncError propagates from sync orchestrator and CLI, multi-repo/unknown-env/unknown-format rejection, partial VEX suppression, zero deps. pytest.raises(Exception) is acceptable at ATDD level where specific exception type is a Step 9 implementation detail.

criteria.name: Anti-Hardcoding
criteria.note: No hardcoded test counts. Assertions use > 0, structural presence checks, and equality comparisons against fixtures. CVE IDs and PURLs are domain constants from mock inventory, not magic values. State transitions use enum values, not raw strings.

criteria.name: Cross-Step Alignment
criteria.note: Step 4 tests inherited via wildcard import. Step 6 components imported by exact name from step6_tdd_green_phase.py. Orchestration stubs define complete enough interfaces for Step 8 (unit tests) and Step 9 (implementation): constructor parameters, return types, state machine enums all explicit.

criteria.name: Domain Appropriateness
criteria.note: Terminology matches SBOM domain: PURL, CPE, CVE, CycloneDX 1.4, SPDX 2.3, VEX. Severity levels match CQ-1 resolution (High/Medium/Low). State names match DDM extraction ledger exactly. Staleness threshold matches spec (7 days).

summary: All 8 criteria pass. 0 weighted failures against a threshold of 3. No Assert triggered. No revision pass needed. The test file is cleared for use as the Step 7 ATDD deliverable.
